# Routes

What `query run` plans for each question shape, and the commands each program runs. Use it when a bundle escalates or misses part of the question.

## `existence`

Whether something specific happened or is mentioned at all, or happened again (did I visit X again, any reference to X).

- **existence_concept** — when `rare_term and entities >= 1`: `artmind query entity-resolve`
- **absence** — when `negative`: `artmind query graph pattern7`, `artmind query vector-text`
- **one_step** — default: `artmind query graph pattern7`, `artmind query survey`

## `enumeration`

A complete list of every recorded item of some kind (all the X, every Y, the recorded Z).

- **class_listing** — when `named_class == 1`: `artmind query graph pattern1`, `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`
- **draw_connected** — when `entities >= 1`: `artmind query entity-context`, `artmind query graph pattern7`, `artmind query survey`
- **enumeration** — default: `artmind query graph pattern7`, `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`

## `aggregate`

A count, total, average or frequency over events or entities, when no saved query fits.

- **kinship_aggregate** — when `twins > 0`: `artmind query entity-context`, `artmind query graph text2cypher`, `artmind query survey`
- **one_step** — default: `artmind query graph text2cypher`, `artmind query survey`

## `superlative`

The favourite, most, least, top or best item of a kind; a ranking that has to be inferred, not a stored fact.

- **one_step** — when `insights_snapshot == 0`: `artmind query graph text2cypher`, `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`
- **one_step** — default: `artmind query graph text2cypher`, `artmind query insights list`, `artmind query survey`

## `entity_profile`

Who or what one specific person, place, organisation or thing is, and what is known about it.

- **entity_visits** — when `occurrence`: `artmind query entity-context`, `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`
- **one_step** — default: `artmind query entity-context`, `artmind query survey`

## `entity_history`

How what is known about one entity changed over time, including facts later corrected or removed.

- **history** — default: `artmind query entity-history`, `artmind query survey`

Read: `references/temporal.md`

## `time_history`

Which version of a document applied on a date, or what an earlier, superseded version of a document said.

- **topic_history** — when `not document and topic_family >= 1`: `artmind query graph pattern10`, `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`
- **history** — default: `artmind query document-history`, `artmind query graph pattern10`, `artmind query survey`

Read: `references/temporal.md`

## `conflicts`

Whether documents or sources disagree or contradict each other, or which of two versions applies.

- **one_step** — default: `artmind query graph conflicts`, `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`

Read: `references/conflicts.md`

## `hierarchy`

Who or what sits under, above or within something in a chain (reports, departments, parts of a whole).

- **one_step** — default: `artmind query entity-context`, `artmind query graph hierarchy`, `artmind query survey`

Read: `references/hierarchy.md`

## `path`

How two named people, places or things are related or connected to each other.

- **one_step** — default: `artmind query graph pattern5`, `artmind query graph pattern6`, `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`

## `document`

What one named document says, or a summary of that document.

- **topic_latest** — when `latest and not document and topic_family >= 1`: `artmind query graph pattern10`
- **latest** — when `latest and document`: `artmind query graph pattern10`
- **one_step** — default: `artmind query graph pattern10`, `artmind query survey`

## `inventory`

Which documents of some kind exist in a domain or corpus (what SOPs, which policies, what notes).

- **one_step** — default: `artmind query domains-overview`, `artmind query graph pattern1`

## `structured`

Numbers held in structured tables (accounts, cases, customers), alone or joined with what policy says about them.

- **sequence** — default: `artmind db bridge`, `artmind query text2sql`
- **analytical** (store kind): `artmind query text2sql`
- **hybrid** (store kind): `artmind db bridge`, `artmind query text2sql`
- **records_plus_guidance** (store kind): `artmind db bridge`, `artmind query text2sql`, `artmind query vector-text`

Read: `references/structured-store.md`

## `insights`

What changed recently, who or what matters most, or who the user lost touch with; patterns across the whole domain.

- **one_step** — default: `artmind query insights list`, `artmind query survey`

## `filing`

Notes filed under a tag, a project or an area.

- **one_step** — default: `artmind query graph filing-listing`, `artmind query survey`

## `survey`

What several documents say about one topic, compared or summarised across them; an overview that no single passage holds.

- **cross_document** — default: `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`

## `search`

Any other factual question, or how to do something (steps, checks, escalation), answered from the text of the documents.

- **cross_document** — default: `artmind query survey`, `artmind query vector-text`
